maryam.heading: Hi, I'm Maryam
maryam.text:
*We have some amazing farms in Oxfordshire. As well as growing tasty veg, they are restoring our soils, creating climate resilience, and working with nature.*

The farmers I've spoken to have so much passion, but also struggle with overtime and low pay, fighting to keep their farm business afloat. At the same time, many people don't know where to buy local veg yet are keen to support local farms rather than supermarkets which exploit farms and consumers for profit.

(There are many Saturday markets you should visit - scroll to the bottom of this page to find them.)

Open on Sundays, I'm hoping to bridge a gap between supermarkets and farmers markets, with easy packaging, sliding scale pricing, and lots of seasonal recipes. So if you're not sure about muddy carrots or want to learn how to cook a celeriac please do come down! And if you're already passionate, I'm more than happy to natter away about agroecology at the counter.

Once you've actually 'tasted the difference' (to steal Sainsbury's brand line), it will be hard to beat local eggs, bread, and veg all harvested/baked the day before eating it.
